title: Model Registry sklearn tutorial: RandomForest logging needs skops_trusted_types for the Tree type
answers: Why does logging a RandomForest with mlflow.sklearn.log_model fail with an untrusted type error under default skops serialization?
How do I allow a custom or sklearn type when logging a scikit-learn model with skops?
Where is the Model Registry tutorial's random forest registration example?
What should input_example be when registering a sklearn model in the tutorial?
body:
Path: docs/docs/classic-ml/model-registry/tutorial.mdx is the Model Registry tutorial; its RandomForestRegressor example trains a model, then calls mlflow.sklearn.log_model with registered_model_name, input_example and the new skops_trusted_types argument.
Rule: With the default scikit-learn `skops` serialization, a RandomForest contains the `sklearn.tree._tree.Tree` type, which is untrusted by default. Pass it explicitly as `skops_trusted_types=["sklearn.tree._tree.Tree"]` to mlflow.sklearn.log_model. Only list types you have reviewed, and link readers to the Pickle-Free Model format docs.
Symptom: Following the Model Registry tutorial, the RandomForest logging/registration step failed under default skops serialization because the model contains the untrusted Tree type.
Constraints: Applies to the sklearn flavor with default skops serialization. It does not apply to pickle serialization or to other flavors. The tutorial also uses `input_example=X_train[:2]` (a small slice) instead of the full training set.
applies: Scope: MLflow sklearn flavor logging and Model Registry tutorial examples that use default skops serialization with tree-based models.
says: Following the model registry tutorial fails when saving a random forest model.
Logging a random forest model produces an untrusted type error in the tutorial.
Model registry tutorial instructions for scikit learn need updated trusted types configuration.
Registering a tree model in the tutorial fails under default serialization settings.
search: The Model Registry tutorial in docs/docs/classic-ml/model-registry/tutorial.mdx requires passing skops_trusted_types with sklearn.tree._tree.Tree when calling mlflow.sklearn.log_model for a RandomForest. Because default skops serialization marks tree types as untrusted, tutorial examples must explicitly configure skops_trusted_types and link readers to Pickle-Free Model format documentation. Without this parameter, executing the RandomForestRegressor registration step in the tutorial raises an untrusted type error. This requirement applies only to scikit-learn flavor logging under default skops serialization, not to pickle serialization or other model flavors.
